headline.zh: 运营实践者 / Web3 研究与交易实践 / AI 工具使用者
headline.en: Operations / Web3 Research & Trading / AI Workflows

zh: 我是 7obu，也使用 7obu.eth 这个公开昵称。过去的工作更靠近民宿、门店和客户服务：接待、订单、OTA 页面、现场协调、物资与资料整理，都是日常的一部分。
我参与加密货币交易已有 9 年。除了交易所和钱包的日常使用，我也持续关注链上交易、DeFi、空投和新项目。研究一个项目时，我会先看公开资料、团队与融资、代币机制、链上数据、社区反馈和安全风险，再决定是否继续投入时间。
现在我把一线运营经验、Web3 研究习惯和 AI 工具放在一起使用。重复资料先交给工具归类、比较和生成初稿，再由自己核对来源并判断取舍；做网站也是同样的方式，先把真实需求做成能用的页面，再逐步补齐细节。
影像内容也是我持续在做的部分。宣传片需要时，我会自己整理拍摄思路和镜头清单，用索尼相机完成地面画面，用大疆无人机补充空间和环境视角，再在达芬奇或剪映里完成剪辑、基础调色、字幕、声音和成片输出。宣传图、平台封面和日常图片也会自己处理。
en: I go by 7obu and use 7obu.eth as my public handle. My earlier work was grounded in homestay, store, and guest-service operations, where reception, orders, OTA listings, on-site coordination, inventory, and documentation were part of the routine.

I have been trading in crypto markets for nine years. Beyond exchanges and wallets, I continue to follow on-chain activity, DeFi, airdrops, and new projects. Before spending more time on a project, I look at public sources, the team and funding, token mechanics, on-chain data, community feedback, and security risks.

I now combine hands-on operations experience, Web3 research habits, and AI tools. Repetitive material gets organized, compared, and drafted first, then I check the sources and make the final call. I take the same approach to websites: build a useful version around a real need, then improve it through careful iterations.

Visual production is another part of my work. For a promotional video, I can prepare the shooting plan, capture ground footage with a Sony camera, add aerial and location views with a DJI drone, then handle the edit, basic color work, subtitles, sound, and delivery in DaVinci Resolve or Jianying. I also prepare promotional graphics, platform covers, and everyday image assets.

focus.zh: 继续完善 Liu OS，整理 U 卡、加密入门和 Web3 项目研究资料，并把 Codex、Obsidian 与多 Agent 分工变成更稳定的个人研究和创作工作流。
focus.en: Improving Liu OS, organizing U-card, beginner crypto, and Web3 project research, and making Codex, Obsidian, and multi-agent task splitting a more dependable research and creative workflow.

summary.zh: 把个人资料、项目、工具和小应用放进一个可操作的 macOS 风格桌面。
summary.en: An interactive macOS-inspired desktop for profile information, projects, tools, and small local apps.

background.zh: 普通作品集页面不适合持续放入工具、文档和实验功能，因此我以开源桌面项目为基础，逐步改造成自己的个人系统。
background.en: A conventional portfolio was too limited for tools, documents, and experiments, so I started from an open-source desktop project and gradually reshaped it into a personal system.

motivation.zh: 希望有一个能打开工具、记录笔记，也能持续更新的个人工作台。
motivation.en: I wanted a personal workspace for tools, notes, and ongoing projects.

problem.zh: 需要让窗口、Dock、语言、主题、数据和移动端交互共存，并保持桌面体验清晰稳定。
problem.en: The challenge is keeping windows, Dock behavior, language, themes, data, and mobile interaction coherent and stable.

zh: 梳理网站内容和功能结构
用 Codex 协助阅读、修改和测试 React 代码
持续校对交互、移动端与数据存储
en: Defined the site content and feature structure
Used Codex to inspect, modify, and test the React codebase
Continuously reviewed interactions, mobile behavior, and data storage

zh: 原项目内容和个人资料混在组件中
复杂窗口中的语言状态容易不同步
外部网站和媒体受浏览器安全策略限制
en: Upstream content and personal data were mixed into components
Language could drift out of sync across open windows
External sites and media are constrained by browser security policies

zh: 把公开资料集中到配置文件
所有界面订阅同一语言状态
说明资源无法加载的原因，并提供外部打开入口
en: Subscribed every interface to one language state
Explained loading restrictions and added links to open resources externally

zh: 逐步精简首屏资源体积
en: Reduce initial bundle size over time

summary.zh: 一个手机端优先、无需登录、答案只保存在本地的互动答案册，支持选择题、自由书写和图片或 Word 导出。
summary.en: A mobile-first interactive journal with no account required, local-only answers, guided choices, free writing, and image or Word exports.

background.zh: 很多自我记录产品要求注册或把内容同步到云端，也常把题目做成一次性测试。这个项目把主题题库、连续回答和可保存结果放进一个无需登录的轻量网页。
background.en: Many reflection products require accounts or cloud storage and reduce prompts to one-off quizzes. This project keeps themed prompts, ongoing answers, and exportable results in a lightweight no-login experience.

motivation.zh: 希望用户能在不交出私人答案的前提下，认真回答一些关于成长、生活、关系、工作与金钱的问题，并把结果留在自己手里。
motivation.en: The goal was to let people reflect on growth, life, relationships, work, and money without giving their private answers to a server.

problem.zh: 需要在手机小屏上兼顾 354 条题目、两种回答方式、进度续接和长内容导出，同时确保刷新后可以继续，数据不会上传。
problem.en: The product needed to handle 354 prompts, two answer modes, resumable progress, and long-form exports on small screens while keeping data local.

zh: 多页 PNG 与 Word 答案册导出
网页与原生微信小程序共用题库
en: Shared prompt library for web and native WeChat mini-program

zh: 梳理产品流程、主题结构与题库规则
用 Codex 协助实现和测试网页及微信小程序
设计本地保存、断点续答和导出体验
完成开源整理、README 与在线发布
en: Defined the product flow, theme structure, and prompt rules
Used Codex to implement and test the web app and WeChat mini-program
Designed local persistence, resume, and export flows
Prepared the open-source repository, documentation, and deployment

zh: 长答案与完整结果需要稳定分页导出
用户中途退出后仍要准确恢复进度
网页与小程序需要共用同一套题库数据
隐私说明必须与实际存储行为保持一致
en: Long answers and full results required reliable paginated exports
Progress had to resume accurately after leaving
Web and mini-program builds needed one shared prompt source
Privacy copy had to match actual storage behavior

zh: 按内容长度生成多页图片，并为书写主题提供 Word 导出
使用本地存储保存主题、题目、答案与进度
通过生成脚本同步网页题库到小程序
不接入账号、数据库或上传接口，明确本地保存边界
en: Generated multi-page images by content length and added Word export for writing themes
Stored theme, prompt, answer, and progress state locally
Generated mini-program data from the web prompt source
Avoided accounts, databases, and upload APIs while documenting local-only boundaries

status.zh: 已开源并上线，可直接体验

zh: 继续完善无障碍与导出模板
探索用户主动备份、导入和更多主题
微信小程序正式发布仍需后续提交审核
en: Explore user-controlled backup, import, and more themes
Submit the WeChat mini-program for review when ready

summary.zh: 把加密消费卡的返现、费用、KYC、地区限制和常见问题整理成可比较的页面。
summary.en: A comparison reference for crypto payment cards, covering rewards, fees, KYC, regional limits, and common questions.

background.zh: 相关信息分散在产品页面、公告和社区讨论中，查看时很难快速横向比较。
background.en: Relevant details were scattered across product pages, announcements, and community discussions, making side-by-side comparison difficult.

motivation.zh: 先为自己的选择过程做一份结构化清单，再把适合公开的部分整理成网页。
motivation.en: It began as a structured checklist for my own research and later became a public reference page.

problem.zh: 同一张卡在不同地区、时间和活动下的费用与权益可能变化，资料必须标明边界并持续核对。
problem.en: Fees and benefits can change by region, date, and campaign, so the data needs clear boundaries and regular verification.

zh: 整理移动端可读的静态页面
不同来源的字段口径不一致
保留风险提示并避免把旧信息写成永久结论
en: Normalized information into a shared schema
Kept risk notes visible and avoided presenting dated information as permanent

status.zh: 已发布静态版本，资料仍需定期复核
status.en: Public static version available; data still needs periodic review

zh: 补充更新时间与来源说明
继续改善筛选与比较体验
en: Add clearer update dates and source notes

summary.zh: 面向新手的单页入门路径，先讲安全，再介绍交易所、钱包、U 卡与常见问题。
summary.en: A single-page beginner path that starts with safety, then introduces exchanges, wallets, U cards, and common questions.

background.zh: 新手资料常把概念、操作和推广链接混在一起，容易忽略最先应该了解的安全问题。
background.en: Beginner material often mixes concepts, instructions, and promotion while giving too little attention to safety.

motivation.zh: 把自己反复解释的基础内容整理成更清楚的阅读顺序。
motivation.en: I wanted a clearer reading order for foundational topics I found myself explaining repeatedly.

problem.zh: 既要让内容容易理解，也不能把高风险操作写成无条件建议。
problem.en: The content needed to stay approachable without turning risky actions into unconditional advice.

zh: 完成静态页面与 GitHub Pages 发布
en: Wrote and reviewed the public explanations
Built and published the static GitHub Pages site

zh: 部分术语对新手不友好
en: Many terms are unfriendly to beginners

zh: 使用短段落和分步结构
把风险提示放在操作说明之前
en: Used short sections and step-by-step structure
Placed risk notes before operational instructions

status.zh: 已发布，可继续校对与更新
status.en: Published and available for continued review and updates

zh: 继续检查外部链接和过时内容
en: Continue checking external links and outdated material

summary.zh: 使用摄像头手势与浏览器声音能力做的空气吉他互动实验。
summary.en: A browser experiment that combines camera-based gestures with web audio for an air-guitar interaction.

background.zh: 这是一次把手势识别、音频反馈和网页交互放在同一个页面里的练习。
background.en: This was a practice project for combining hand tracking, audio feedback, and browser interaction in one page.

motivation.zh: 想验证不依赖专用硬件时，浏览器能否提供有即时反馈的轻量互动。
motivation.en: I wanted to test whether a browser could deliver responsive interaction without dedicated hardware.

problem.zh: 摄像头权限、环境光和设备性能都会影响手势识别的稳定性。
problem.en: Camera permission, lighting, and device performance all affect gesture stability.

zh: 调试摄像头与声音反馈
不同设备的识别效果不一致
浏览器对自动播放和权限有明确限制
en: Browsers enforce strict autoplay and permission rules

zh: 由用户主动授权摄像头和声音
把实验定位和设备限制写清楚
en: Required explicit camera and audio permission
Explained the experimental nature and device limitations

status.en: A public experimental build is available

zh: 继续改善弱光与移动端反馈
补充更清楚的首次使用提示

title.zh: 多 Agent 与 Obsidian 工作流

summary.zh: 把代码、资料研究、内容整理和复盘分给不同 AI 角色，再用本地知识库保存可复用结论。
summary.en: A personal workflow that separates coding, research, content organization, and review across AI roles, with reusable conclusions stored locally.

background.zh: 任务变长以后，聊天记录和结论很容易散落，重复解释也会增加。
background.en: As tasks grew longer, decisions became scattered across conversations and the same context had to be repeated.

motivation.zh: 希望在长任务中保留清楚的上下文和结论，减少反复解释与重复工作。
motivation.en: The goal is to keep context and decisions clear across long tasks while reducing repeated explanations and duplicated work.

problem.zh: 不同 Agent 的上下文和输出格式需要统一，否则资料会越来越难维护。
problem.en: Context and output formats need to stay consistent across agents or the workspace becomes harder to maintain.

zh: 持续记录失败原因和修复方式
en: Recorded failure causes and fixes over time

zh: 长期资料容易重复或冲突
多个角色的结论需要统一归档
en: Long-running notes can duplicate or conflict
Conclusions from different roles need one shared structure

zh: 发布前检查事实与链接
把结论整理成可复用的任务记录
en: Checked facts and links before publishing
Turned conclusions into reusable task records

status.zh: 持续进行的个人工作流实践

zh: 为常见任务补充可验证的检查清单
en: Add verifiable checklists for recurring tasks

title.zh: 加密市场交易与 Web3 研究

context.zh: 交易所、钱包、链上生态与项目研究
context.en: Exchanges, wallets, on-chain ecosystems, and project research

summary.zh: 持续参与加密货币市场交易 9 年，也在实际使用中逐步扩展到钱包、链上交易、DeFi、空投与项目研究。
summary.en: Nine years of personal crypto-market trading, with hands-on use gradually expanding into wallets, on-chain transactions, DeFi, airdrops, and project research.

zh: 使用中心化交易所与钱包完成日常交易和资产操作
通过 DEX、跨链桥、DeFi 协议与区块浏览器完成链上操作
跟踪融资、产品、代币机制、上线节奏、链上数据与社区信息
关注空投、测试网、交易所活动和新生态，并优先核对官方来源
把市场信息整理成观察清单，区分事实、情绪和未经证实的传言
en: Used centralized exchanges and wallets for day-to-day trading and asset operations
Worked with DEXs, bridges, DeFi protocols, and block explorers for on-chain activity
Tracked funding, products, token mechanics, launch timelines, on-chain data, and community signals
Followed airdrops, testnets, exchange campaigns, and new ecosystems while checking official sources first
Organized market information into watchlists that separate facts, sentiment, and unverified claims

learning.zh: 长期参与市场后，更看重账户与钱包安全、来源核验和风险控制，也接受每一次判断都可能出错。
learning.en: Long-term market participation has made account and wallet security, source verification, and risk control more important than chasing every move, while accepting that any market judgment can be wrong.

status.zh: 持续进行的个人研究与交易实践
status.en: Ongoing personal research and trading practice

context.zh: 多地民宿与门店运营场景
context.en: Homestay and store operations across multiple sites

summary.zh: 从日常门店运行到新店筹备，处理接待、订单、现场协调、物资和服务问题。
summary.en: Worked across daily store operations and opening preparation, covering guests, orders, on-site coordination, supplies, and service issues.

zh: 协调前台、客房、餐饮、采购等日常事项
跟进客人到店前信息、现场需求与投诉
整理物资、库存、账目、报表和 SOP
参与排班、活动执行与新店开业准备
en: Coordinated reception, housekeeping, dining, and purchasing tasks
Followed up on pre-arrival details, on-site requests, and complaints
Organized inventory, accounts, reports, and SOP documents
Supported rosters, events, and opening preparation

learning.zh: 现场运营最重要的是信息清楚、责任明确，并且给临时变化留出处理空间。
learning.en: Clear information, clear ownership, and room for unexpected changes matter most in day-to-day operations.

status.en: Completed; lessons are still being organized

context.zh: 民宿、门店和本地生活内容

summary.zh: 维护平台页面与套餐资料，也独立完成过宣传片和日常内容的拍摄、剪辑、图片处理与交付。
summary.en: Maintained platform listings and packages, and independently produced promotional and day-to-day content from shooting through editing and delivery.

zh: 整理携程、美团、飞猪等平台页面与套餐
参与抖音团购和小红书内容准备
使用索尼相机和大疆无人机完成地面与航拍素材
使用达芬奇和剪映完成剪辑、调色、字幕与成片输出
处理宣传图片、海报、菜单和平台用图
根据淡旺季、活动和现场反馈调整信息
en: Organized Ctrip, Meituan, and Fliggy listings and packages
Prepared material for Douyin group deals and Xiaohongshu
Captured ground and aerial footage with Sony cameras and DJI drones
Edited, color-corrected, subtitled, and delivered videos with DaVinci Resolve and Jianying
Prepared promotional images, posters, menus, and platform graphics
Adjusted information around seasons, campaigns, and on-site feedback

learning.zh: 页面信息、现场体验和客人沟通是同一条链路，不能只优化其中一段。
learning.en: Listing information, the on-site experience, and guest communication are one connected journey.

status.zh: 经验持续用于内容和网站整理
status.en: The experience continues to inform content and site work

summary.zh: 负责基础商务沟通、资料跟进和关系维护，也培养了准确记录与及时反馈的习惯。
summary.en: Handled basic business communication, material follow-up, and relationship maintenance while building habits around accurate records and timely feedback.

en: Followed up on routine communication and materials

learning.zh: 沟通后及时整理记录，跟进资料和反馈。
learning.en: Keep notes after conversations and follow up on materials and feedback.

title.zh: 宣传片与影像内容制作

context.zh: 门店、空间、活动和旅行内容
context.en: Stores, spaces, events, and travel content

summary.zh: 可以独立完成从拍摄准备、地面与航拍素材采集，到剪辑、基础调色、字幕、声音和多平台输出的完整流程。
summary.en: Can independently take a visual project from shooting preparation and ground or aerial capture through editing, basic color work, subtitles, sound, and multi-platform delivery.

zh: 根据空间、活动或产品整理拍摄思路与镜头清单
使用索尼相机拍摄人物、环境和细节画面
使用大疆无人机补充空间关系、环境和移动镜头
在达芬奇或剪映中整理素材并完成剪辑、调色、字幕与声音
根据抖音、小红书、OTA 页面和线下展示要求输出不同版本
处理照片、宣传图、封面、菜单和平台详情图片
en: Prepared shooting plans and shot lists around a space, event, or product
Captured people, environments, and detail shots with Sony cameras
Used DJI drones for spatial context, location views, and moving shots
Organized footage and completed editing, color work, subtitles, and sound in DaVinci Resolve or Jianying
Delivered versions for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, OTA listings, and on-site display
Edited photos, promotional graphics, covers, menus, and platform detail images

learning.zh: 一个人完成全流程时，前期镜头清单和素材管理会直接影响后期效率，也决定成片是否围绕真实使用场景。
learning.en: When one person owns the full process, the shot list and media organization shape both editing efficiency and whether the finished piece fits its real use.

status.zh: 持续用于内容和宣传项目
status.en: Used in ongoing content and promotional projects

context.zh: 个人工作流与公开项目

summary.zh: 使用 GPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Codex 做资料整理、任务拆解、代码修改与测试，产出可实际访问的个人项目。
summary.en: Use GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Codex for research organization, task breakdown, code changes, and testing across usable personal projects.

zh: 把实际需求拆成可验证的功能
阅读和修改 React、Vite 与 Tailwind 项目
使用 Git 记录修改并通过 GitHub Pages 发布部分项目
在 Obsidian 中维护项目索引与复盘
en: Turned real needs into verifiable features
Inspected and modified React, Vite, and Tailwind projects
Used Git to track changes and GitHub Pages for selected public projects
Maintained project indexes and reviews in Obsidian

learning.zh: 我用 AI 整理资料和起草代码，再检查来源、链接和功能。
learning.en: I use AI to organize research and draft code, then check the sources, links, and features.

description.zh: 9 年个人交易与市场参与经验，重点放在信息核验、链上工具和风险判断。
description.en: Nine years of personal trading and market participation, with an emphasis on source checks, on-chain tools, and risk judgment.

name.zh: 加密市场交易与风险意识

description.zh: 把 AI 当作研究、整理和开发助手，最终结果由自己检查。
description.en: Using AI for research, organization, and development assistance, with human review at the end.

description.zh: 来自民宿、门店和本地服务的一线工作经验。
description.en: Hands-on experience from homestay, store, and local-service settings.

description.zh: 可以一个人完成宣传片从前期准备、现场拍摄到后期成片的完整流程。
description.en: Able to carry a promotional video from preparation and on-site shooting through final post-production independently.

name.zh: 索尼相机与大疆无人机

description.zh: 能在现有项目中完成实际修改、调试和静态发布，并持续补基础。
description.en: Able to make practical changes, debug existing projects, and publish static sites while continuing to build fundamentals.

description.zh: 整理报表、说明文档、培训资料和项目笔记。
description.en: Reports, documentation, training material, and project notes.
